title: AutoScheduler launches warehouse app builder for logistics teams
summary: AutoScheduler launched a warehouse app builder enabling logistics teams to create custom tools directly from live facility data, integrated into their Warehouse AI Platform for distribution centers managing inventory, machinery, and labor.
problem_solved: Enables logistics teams to overcome rigid enterprise resource planning and warehouse management system limitations by building custom applications from real-time data.
why_valuable: Provides flexibility and customization for warehouse operations that traditional enterprise systems cannot offer, improving efficiency in distribution center management.
